clips.title: The story
paras: Covert Ops - Alpha is an Alliance infiltration mission directed by the gnome tinker Gaxim Rustfizzle in the Stonetalon Mountains. While operating out of the peaks, operatives are tasked with penetrating the Venture Company's lumber mill in Windshear Crag to recover proprietary engineering schematics. Securing these blueprints allows the Alliance to decipher the mechanical vulnerabilities of goblin machinery while co-opting their logging technology.

Operating from Windshear Crag, Gaxim Rustfizzle conducts a persistent covert campaign to disrupt the aggressive logging operations of the Venture Company. While goblin deforesters fell the primeval timber south of Cragpool Lake, Gaxim recognizes that wanton destruction alone cannot halt the enterprise. Instead of merely detonating industrial hardware, Plan Alpha prioritizes intelligence gathering, requiring agents to slip past goblin loggers and overseers to seize their core technical schematics directly from the lumber mill.

Gnomish interest in the Venture Company extends beyond ecological sympathy for the night elves. The recovered schematics detail the inner workings of heavy-duty goblin loggers, mechanical cutters, and mechanized transports. By studying these blueprints, Alliance engineers can expose critical structural flaws to dismantle future operations—while simultaneously borrowing refined goblin designs to enhance their own mechanical projects back in Ironforge.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This is it, friend. Pay close attention. The devices are done, and ready to be used.
Take these pages—they'll explain more about the detonators and explosives, and where you should place them.

Remember, the success of your mission doesn't depend on how much destruction you cause. Plan Alpha's success depends on you bringing back the Venture Co.'s engineering plans from inside the lumber mill south of Cragpool Lake.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you get the plans, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Truly amazing! This is a huge blow to the Venture Co.
We'll be able to find weaknesses in their machines and also incorporate their designs into our own creations. This is a wonderful day, indeed.
